title: Reject non-dictionary flow records before migration
answers: Why does loading a malformed flow dump fail unexpectedly?
How should the flow reader handle a null record?
Where should decoded flow records be validated?
body:
Symptom: Loading a malformed flow dump containing a null record fails without the intended invalid-flow handling.
Root cause: mitmproxy/io/io.py:FlowReader passed decoded tnetstring values to flow migration without checking that they were dictionaries.
Fix pattern: Validate the decoded value before migration inside the existing ValueError handler, so invalid records become FlowReadException errors.
Constraints: Applies to tnetstring flow records; the dictionary check validates the outer type only, not the contents of a flow state.
applies: Reading tnetstring flow dumps through FlowReader, especially malformed records that decode successfully.
